boundary.manager: worker resources, physical dispatch, physical completion, opaque auxiliary payload only
boundary.scheduler: logical dependencies and immediate child readiness; logical DONE is immutable during data recovery
boundary.controller: DataID identity, indexed worker sessions and replicas, admission, liveness, GC, persistence, exact faults, and deduplicated recovery requests
boundary.worker_agent: local paths, inventory, atomic install, pins, disk pressure, peer transfer, digest verification, and physical deletion

correctness_rules: at most one queued, running, or admission-waiting replay per logical producer
recovery never rolls Scheduler DONE backward or releases children twice
successful replay availability is read from the Controller replica table, not the Manager result table
stale generation and GC tombstone publications are per-record idempotent no-ops
generic peer refusal or timeout retries locally and does not revoke a source replica
only an exact authenticated source fault, worker-session loss, or local integrity and I/O failure revokes a replica

bounded_recovery_closure_gate.injection: one 8-core Worker removed after 1988 physical completions with mixed A/B data resident
bounded_recovery_closure_gate.overall_runner_status: FAIL only because the deliberately delayed replacement reduced the central active-core sample fraction; every correctness, data, GC, count, output, and final-pool gate passed

bounded_origin_replacement_gate.injection: four of eight 8-core Workers removed after 1772 physical completions
bounded_origin_replacement_gate.overall_runner_status: FAIL only because the deliberate half-pool interval reduced the central active-core sample fraction; every correctness, data, GC, count, output, ready-frontier, and final-pool gate passed

strict_admission_diagnostic.reason_stopped: A timing audit proved that post-submit timing can omit native setup and early physical work. The final timer starts before sealed submission.

claim_boundary: Recovery correctness, strict ownership, and admit-before-seal ordering pass local and injected-loss gates. A full-scale performance advantage remains OPEN until one exact 128x16 million-task DataVine run and its same-resource TaskVine baseline both terminate with every gate true.
